title: periballia minuta subsp. australis
intro: Periballia minuta subsp. australis, commonly known as New Zealand periballia or kawakawa, is a plant species native to New Zealand. As a traditional Maori herbal medicine, it is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Periballia minuta subsp. australis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, particularly the polyphenol kawakawin, have been identified as the primary source of its medicinal properties.
